summary: Verified fix for /api/admin/seller-applications 502 error. Ran 12 pytest cases including 10 back-to-back calls to the endpoint, status filter variants (pending/approved/rejected), real-user-first ordering, and regression on other admin endpoints (users/stores/orders with and without ?real_only=1). All 12 tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Escrow digest fix looks correct: short-circuit when mailer breaker open + persisted last_run_at in db.settings prevents hot-reload re-triggers. Consider adding a metric/log line for how many digest runs were skipped due to breaker to aid future observability.
server.py is very large (~7000+ lines) - consider splitting admin routes and background loops into separate modules.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fix for 502 on /api/admin/seller-applications verified. Endpoint returns 200 across 10 consecutive calls; filters and regressions clean. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_seller_apps_502.py can be reused as regression suite.
rca of the issue: escrow_digest_loop scanned ~224 orders on each restart and attempted SMTP send for every one; Hostinger SMTP is offline in this env so each attempt hit the mailer circuit-breaker but the loop still blocked the event loop for 30-60s, causing intermittent 502s on admin endpoints. Fix: (1) _dispatch_escrow_digest short-circuits when mailer._circuit_open() is True; (2) last_run_at persisted in db.settings so hot reloads don't retrigger. Verified by 10 back-to-back requests all returning 200.
